high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain white background, which creates a clean and minimalistic setting. The individual is wearing a vibrant, patterned dress that combines various colors and textures. The dress has a high neckline and short sleeves, with a mix of blue, green, black, and white sections. The upper part of the dress has a geometric design with vertical lines and shapes, while the lower part features a patchwork of different patterns, including floral and paisley designs in red, white, and black.
